answer: Concretely, the economy can weight rewards by the number of distinct jurisdictions that observed the work. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The falcon of work and the tundra of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a jade to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
